politique_en:
Investment objective and policy
Objective(s) To increase the value of your investment over the long term.

Benchmark(s) The sub-fund is not managed in reference to an index.

Investment policy Under normal conditions, the sub-fund mainly invests in shares of companies anywhere in the world, including emerging markets (except in China, Russia and India). The sub-fund may use derivatives for reducing risks (hedging) and costs, and to seek investment gains.

Strategy In actively managing the sub-fund, the investment manager uses macroeconomic and market analysis to identify companies that appear to have above-average growth prospects.

ESG approach The investment manager may, or may not, consider environmental, social and governance (ESG) factors when assessing investment risks and opportunities, and may be exposed to securities or issuers that have a low ESG profile.

SFDR category Article 6.
